info.name: HustleHub+ Part 2 - API Tests
info.description: HustleHub+ Part 2 API collection, grouped by domain. Run the folders in order: each run registers unique accounts and captures JWTs and IDs automatically. The admin account must be provisioned locally and its password passed at run time. 08 Rate Limiting runs last and uses up the failed-login limit, and each run makes eight of the ten registration requests allowed per hour, so restart the API before the next full run. From the api folder, run `npm run test:api`.
